messages:
Amy: Quick check — final readiness pass for new opt-13b-q4 model.

Amy: Where are the canonical weights now? CI failed to pull from the path in the onboarding doc.

Devin: weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/opt-13b/q4/weights.tar.gz (sha256: abc123def456). verified by uploader.

Marta: noted tokenizer quirk: during short eval runs we saw stray <eos> tokens inserted mid-sequence when using tokenizer v2. small repro attached in PR.

Samir: config we're smoke-testing locally:
```yaml
continuous_batching:
  min_tokens: 8
  max_tokens: 512
  max_batch_size: 16
kv_cache:
  policy: LRU
  ttl_seconds: 3600
scheduler:
  preference: latency
  preempt_threshold: 0.8
max_generation_tokens: 1024
```

Amy: two quick asks: 1) validate that max_generation_tokens=1024 doesn't cause big p99 spikes on long sequences, 2) can we set kv_cache.ttl_seconds to 1800 (30m) for the canary?

Devin: starting a smoke loadgen now against the canary pool. I'll post p99 and memory numbers. pinging infra-bot to ensure the dedicated pool has the gpu flags and OOM protector.

infra-bot: Deploy job #2201 started for pool 'dedicated-opt-13b-q4' — estimated startup 2m. logs: https://ci.redwood/2201.

Marta: re: tokenizer — PR merged to model-index, tokenizer_version: 2.1.1. Important: v2 drops the sentinel mapping for end-of-text; add a remap in serving config to preserve behaviour.

Amy: what's the remap snippet so ops can include it in the canary config?

Marta: ```json
{"tokenizer_remap": {"<|endoftext|>": "<eos>"}}
```

Samir: loadgen preliminary: 1k requests, avg latency 78ms, p99 210ms. Outliers concentrated on sequences >800 tokens. Memory pressure spikes at p99 when batch size hits 16.

Devin: lowered max_batch_size to 12 in scheduler — p99 down to ~160ms, memory stable on 24GB. Suggest default max_batch_size=12 and keep continuous_batching.max_tokens=512.

Amy: good catch. I'll update the canary config: max_batch_size=12, kv_cache.ttl_seconds=1800, max_generation_tokens=1024, and include tokenizer_remap. Starting 10% canary rollout after CI checksum validation.

Samir: small operational note — if we enable prefix KV cache warmup, keep warmup_concurrency <= 2 to avoid OOM on smaller GPUs.

Marta: added that to the rollout notes and added the eval set 'long-context-regressions' to monitor for quality regressions during the canary.

Devin: will add a CI gate that verifies s3 checksum before rollout and a smoke job that asserts p99 < 250ms for sequences <=512 tokens.

Amy: perfect — thanks all. If no objections I'll merge the canary in 30m. :rocket:
